bounded_slice.leaf: Pin the smallest exact-source fail-closed seam for authenticated-principal/ownership enforcement before application-owned tasks/get, tasks/update, and tasks/cancel store access.
observations: The exact ServerHandler dispatcher validates only the Tasks extension capability before forwarding GetTaskParams, UpdateTaskParams, or CancelTaskParams together with RequestContext<RoleServer> to the corresponding handler hook.

The exact RequestContext<RoleServer> surface exposes request id, request meta, public Extensions, and Peer. Its client_capabilities helper returns protocol-declared capabilities and is not an authenticated identity primitive.
Default get_task/update_task/cancel_task hooks are unimplemented method-not-found stubs; ownership authorization is therefore application responsibility when those hooks are overridden.

source_qualified_seam.pattern: Fail closed if no server-authenticated principal is present in trusted RequestContext extensions; when present, make the first application-store operation principal-scoped, e.g. lookup/update/cancel by composite key (principal_id, task_id), rather than globally resolving task_id and authorizing afterward.
source_qualified_seam.why_minimal: The SDK already passes RequestContext into every task hook, so no custom dispatcher is required. Principal-scoped keying prevents unauthenticated access before store touch and avoids a global task-id existence oracle. Update/cancel must preserve the same principal-scoped predicate atomically with the state mutation.
source_qualified_seam.sdk_guarantee_boundary: rmcp-v3.1.4 supplies the context/extension transport seam and Tasks capability gating, but does not itself authenticate a principal, bind task ownership, guarantee persistent storage, provide caller-stable task creation identity, provide restart redrive, or guarantee exactly-once external effects.
source_qualified_seam.authenticated_principal_transport_note: A prior source-qualified role-local finding established that built-in Streamable HTTP metadata is carried through RequestContext extensions as http::request::Parts; trusted HTTP authentication middleware can place Principal in Parts.extensions, after which the task hook can extract it fail-closed. This slice does not re-open or extend that transport finding.

bounded_slice.tested_scope: Static exact-source interface audit only at rust-sdk commit 4a738b9d...; no compile, runtime server, network effect, task materialization, store mutation, or external effect was executed.
bounded_slice.negative_scope_guard: Do not claim that RequestContext client capabilities, request id, client-supplied _meta, or random task ids are ownership/authentication evidence. Do not claim the SDK enforces principal-scoped task access automatically.
bounded_slice.result: A minimal fail-closed ownership seam exists at the public ServerHandler task hooks: derive trusted principal from server-populated RequestContext extensions before access, then make application-owned task storage operations principal-scoped from the first lookup/mutation. Stock rmcp does not supply the ownership policy itself.
